positions.name: ProbeAsAssertionVehicle
positions.frame: What does it mean for a test artifact to declare its own purpose as merely carrying an assertion about the system it tests?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same instrumental self-description: src-1 settles the decision that the e2e suite asserts reviewer enrollment on memory creation, and src-2 frames the probe memory's entire existence as a vehicle for that assertion. The shared directional read is a technical artifact naming its own function — the probe is not content but a carrier. A conviction gradient runs across the set (src-1 performs decision-grade settling via explicit labeling; src-2 reinforces at claim level), but the frame holds both: the question is what it means for a test artifact to self-describe as a mere carrier of an assertion about the system under test.
